entry.title: New: Resolution 530 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-AGENCY MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I, HAWAI‘I HOUSING FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION AND THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAI‘I ECONOMIC RESEARCH ORGANIZATION, PURSUANT TO SECTION 46-7, HAWAI‘I REVISED STATUTES

Allows the Office of Housing and Community Development to collaborate on a State-wide Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing, with an estimated cost to the County of $33,363.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res 530-24 & GOEAC-142 - 06/19/24
